query:
UPDATE products
                    SET category_id = ?1,
                        position = (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(p.position), -1) + 1
                                      FROM products p
                                      WHERE p.owner_id = ?2 AND p.category_id = ?1),
                        updated_at = ?3
                  WHERE id = ?4 AND owner_id = ?2 AND category_id IS NULL
                    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM categories c WHERE c.id = ?1 AND c.owner_id = ?2)
                  RETURNING name
